name: Chuy Garcia
page_title: Chuy Garcia's Issue Positions (Political Courage Test)

positions.question: Do you support the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe v. Wade?

evidence.text: "#RoeVWade saved lives. The loss of Roe is a tragedy for millions of women across the country who no longer have access to a safe abortion. We must continue to fight for the reproductive rights of women and against laws that take away a woman’s right to agency over her own body."

"Thankfully, in Illinois abortion care remains safe and legal. But for low-income communities, communities of color, immigrant communities, and others who cannot travel to a safe state, the impact of overturning Roe V. Wade is dire."
"There is no time left to wait. We need to abolish the filibuster and codify Roe v. Wade."
Rated 100% by Planned Parenthood Action Fund

positions.question: Do you support expanding federal funding to support social safety net programs such as Social Security and Medicare?

evidence.text: "It's long past time that Congress makes improvements to Social Security benefits. My constituents have instead seen cuts, often receiving a poverty-level check after paying into this program their entire working lives. Social Security is a sacred trust we must protect #Secure2100"
"Most Americans contribute to Social Security all year long, but millionaires stop paying in after just two months. It’s time we #ScrapTheCap and make sure everyone pays their fair share!"
Rated 100% by Alliance for Retired Americans
Rated 100% by National Committe to Preserve Social Security and Medicare

evidence.text: "Tax the rich."
"The Inflation Reduction Act: Makes the wealthy pay their fair share in taxes"

"This package does the most we’ve ever done to create green jobs and make green energy affordable. It also lowers prescription drug prices, caps the price of insulin for Medicare recipients, and more than pays for itself by making billionaires pay their fair share of taxes."
Rated 10% by FreedomWorks

positions.question: Do you support the regulation of indirect campaign contributions from corporations, unions, and individuals?

evidence.text: "Proud to stand with @HouseDemocrats in support of #HR1 to protect and expand the sacred right to vote, expose dark money in our politics, empower hardworking Americans, and stop wealthy special interests from buying influence. #ForThePeople"

"Ten years ago #CitizensUnited opened the floodgates to unlimited spending in our elections, giving undue influence to a handful of wealthy individuals and corporations. We must return power to the people by passing #HR1 and overturning this decision. #ForThePeople"
Rated 100% by Common Cause
Voted in favor of H.R. 1 "For the People Act of 2021"

positions.question: Do you support protecting government officials, including law enforcement officers, from personal liability in civil lawsuits concerning alleged misconduct?

evidence.text: "As we honor George Floyd’s life one year after his murder and the lives of others killed by racist, violent policing in the past year, Congress must commit to passing a strong George Floyd #JusticeInPolicingAct and ending qualified immunity. #BlackLivesMatter"

"Over the past 50 years, SCOTUS has developed a doctrine that makes government officials, including police officers, immune from being sued in court when they violate people’s rights. I am proud to support this bill by @justinamash & @RepPressley to end qualified immunity."

"Tyre Nichols should still be alive. I mourn with his family and the entire Memphis community. I appreciate the swift action taken to investigate the officers involved, but we must also address the culture of violence that has plagued law enforcement agencies for too long."
Voted in favor of H.R. 1280 "George Floyd Justice in Policing Act of 2021"

positions.question: Do you support increasing defense spending?

evidence.text: "Congress should be focusing on the urgent human needs in this country—food, housing, health care, and jobs—not rubber-stamping a $740 billion handout to defense contractors and arms manufacturers in the middle of a pandemic."
"It’s time to reduce military spending and invest in the American people’s needs"

"New fighter jets won't help struggling families recover from COVID-19 or put food on their tables. It's time we stop rubber stamping bloated defense budgets and prioritize working people over defense contractors."

"We cannot continue to vote for ever-expanding defense authorizations, while year after year the everyday threats that our communities face—income inequality, access to health care, and gun violence, to name only a few—go unaddressed."

positions.question: Do you support federal spending as a means of promoting economic growth (e.g. grants, tax incentives)?

evidence.text: Voted in favor of H.R. 2 "Moving Forward Act"
Voted in favor of H.R. 5376 "Build Back Better Act"

"I voted to create better paying jobs rebuilding America’s infrastructure, producing clean, secure energy, and expanding opportunities for working families. Extreme MAGA Republicans voted against all of this. Ask them why."
"It's time for Congress to pass the #BuildBackBetter Act, invest in green #infrastructure, provide a pathway to citizenship for immigrants, keep our government open and the lights on."

positions.question: Do you support the federal government increasing funding for affordable housing programs?

evidence.text: "Housing is a human right, let's legislate like it."

"To create thriving communities, we must ensure that residents have access to affordable housing, fully-funded public education systems, and efficient public transportation that provides inexpensive access to job opportunities and other essential services."

"To end homelessness, reduce the racial wealth gap, and make housing more affordable, we must #ShowAffordableHousingLove. NOW is the time to make the necessary investments toward an #EconomyforEveryone!"
"We must make #FairHousing a reality. That means long overdue investments in fair and affordable housing."

positions.question: Do you support the federal government taking action, beyond those of the Federal Reserve, to alleviate inflation?

evidence.text: "Inflation means pain for my constituents, but it's profit for big business. I was shocked to hear corporate execs admit to price gouging the Latino community to make up for lost sales, and I joined @FSCDems today to talk about taking on corporate greed."

"One year ago, Democrats delivered the Inflation Reduction Act, the largest investment in clean energy and climate protections in U.S. history. The bill also lowers prescription drug costs and caps insulin at $35/month for millions. Not a single Republican voted for the bill."

"Today, we received news that our economy had zero percent inflation in July. Zero percent. But there’s still more work to do, and that’s on Friday I will vote for the #InflationReductionAct and send it to @POTUS desk to be signed ASAP."
Voted in favor of HR 5376: "Inflation Reduction Act of 2022"

positions.question: Do you support the forgiveness of federal student loan debt?

evidence.text: "Cancel student debt."

"I support canceling student debt because my constituents deserve the opportunity to pursue higher education without a lifetime of debt. Student debt contributes to the wealth gap and hinders upward mobility particularly among Latino and Black Americans like the ones I represent."

"Student debt contributes to the wealth gap, hindering upward mobility among Latino and Black Americans. With the stroke of a pen @POTUS can help make education a pathway to mobility– not a burden. If we #CancelStudentDebt we can give hope and opportunity to millions of Americans."
"There is literally no good argument against canceling student debt."

positions.question: Do you support requiring a government-issued identification in order to vote at the polls?

evidence.text: "As states across the country enact restrictive, anti-voter laws, it's never been more urgent to protect the sacred right to vote. That’s why I was proud to cast my vote for the John R. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act to restore federal oversight and #RestoreTheVote."

"It’s #NationalVoterRegistrationDay. Our vote is our voice and we can’t take it for granted. Through our history there’ve been consistent efforts to take away our sacred right to vote: from poll taxes, to voter ID laws, to the Big Lie. I’ll ALWAYS fight for our right to vote!"

"The best way to celebrate the anniversary of t The Voting Rights Act (VRA)? #EndtheFilibuster and pass bills like the Freedom to Vote Act and the John Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act. #OnePersonOneVote for Everyone!"
Rated 100% by Common Cause

positions.question: Do you support government funding for the development of renewable energy (e.g. solar, wind, geo-thermal)?

evidence.text: "It's time for Congress to pass the #BuildBackBetter Act, invest in green #infrastructure, provide a pathway to citizenship for immigrants, keep our government open and the lights on."

"The rising costs of climate disasters and the rising costs of energy are falling on working families, while oil and gas companies make record profits. It's time for Big Oil CEOs to stop #RippingOffAmericans – and for America to transition to cleaner, cheaper sources of energy."

"We are at cross roads where we must take rapid action in order to prevent irreparable damage to our environment and climate. I support the Green New Deal because we must reduce our reliance on fossil fuels and move toward a renewable energy economy that includes well-funded strategies for sustainable and increased opportunities for workers and small businesses."

"We need a new generation of skilled labor professionals to build a clean energy workforce, modernize our infrastructure, and strengthen our manufacturing sector. During #NationalApprenticeshipWeek let’s encourage more young people to explore a career in trades."

positions.question: Do you generally support gun-control legislation (e.g. red flag laws, boyfriend loopholes)?

evidence.text: "Today marked the anniversary of Rep. Giffords’ shooting. Parkland activist @davidhogg111 and I honored Gabby Giffords’ courage and strength, but most importantly, we must keep working to prevent senseless acts of gun violence like this again. #BackgroundChecksSaveLives"

"Today, activists from around the country will be out in force in Chicago, DC and in more than 300 cities, towns, and communities nationwide to join @MFOLParkland to say enough is enough. We need the Senate to take action to end the gun violence in our streets, and we need it now."
Rated 0% by Gun Owners of America
Voted in favor of HR 1808: "Assault Weapons Ban of 2022"

positions.question: Do you support a government-run (e.g. single-payer) healthcare program, such as Medicare-for-All?

evidence.text: "Communities of color suffer increased #HealthDisparities due to longstanding inequities in healthcare, air pollution, and nutritional access. That is why I support #HEAA as it addresses these inequities and promote health equity for all."
"Medical debt should not exist. That's part of why I'm fighting for Medicare For All — because no one should be punished for not being able to pay outrageous medical bills."

"Our country needs Medicare for All because every person must have access to affordable and comprehensive healthcare. When healthcare is tied to employment, millions of Americans cannot access health insurance or cannot pay for it because it is too expensive. Because of systemic disparities, Latino, African American and immigrant communities have less access to healthcare--which leaves them with less preventive care and increased long term health problems. Universal healthcare is necessary to correct these issues and to ensure that income, identity, or immigration status do not determine one's access to healthcare."
"Today, I joined my fellow @USProgressives in reintroducing Medicare for All because healthcare is a human right."

positions.question: Do you support expanding paid family AND/OR medical leave benefits (e.g. maternity leave)?

evidence.text: "I stand with airport workers — from the curb to the cabin — demanding better wages and conditions, affordable healthcare, and paid leave. The Senate must include the Good Jobs for Good Airports Act in their upcoming FAA reauthorization."
"I won’t support a deal that doesn’t include paid sick leave for all rail workers."
"Paid family leave is essential and Democrats will continue to fight to keep it in the final package."

"The right to collectively bargain without intimidation or harassment is one of the most important rights for workers in the United States. All workers--including tipped workers, farm and domestic laborers--deserve a livable wage, paid sick leave, and safe working conditions. We must end the offshoring of jobs and corporate attacks on labor rights."

positions.question: Should the government be able to regulate the cost of prescription drugs?

evidence.text: "Health care is a human right. That's why Democrats have taken on the special interests and cut health insurance premiums and prescription drug costs for millions of families and seniors."

"One year ago, Democrats delivered the Inflation Reduction Act, the largest investment in clean energy and climate protections in U.S. history. The bill also lowers prescription drug costs and caps insulin at $35/month for millions. Not a single Republican voted for the bill."

"The price cut for insulin announced yesterday is a step in the right direction. We must continue to fight to reduce prescription drug prices so every person who needs lifesaving medications can afford them."

"We must continue to protect our seniors, that is why I voted for #BBB to lower prescription drug costs including insulin prices so that no one has to pay more than $35 per month. I hope our seniors enjoyed the Resource Fair and Turkey Giveaway!"

"We have heard a lot of fear mongering about immigrants during tonight's #SOTU. However, the crisis at the border is one perpetuated by decades of racist immigration policy & border militarization—causing deaths and family separation. #DefundHate"
"When Trump boasts about his military spending, he is also trying to divert billions of dollars from existing military construction projects to fund his racist border wall."

positions.question: Do you generally support increased regulations on social media companies (e.g. Tik Tok, Facebook, etc.)?

evidence.text: "Against concentration of data in the hands of just one company. @Meta controls @Facebook, @Instagram, and @WhatsApp & needs to hire more multi-lingual staff to help monitor & enforce the platform’s standards, integrity of content and to stop the spread of harmful misinformation."

"I’m at @FSCDems hearing to ask Facebook CEO Mark Zuckerberg about his plans to create the cryptocurency #Libra & digital wallet which raises serious privacy, national security, financial stability & monetary policy concerns. #BigTechTakeover"

"Today, my Close the ILC Loophole Act, introduced with Rep. Lance Gooden was voted out of @FSCDems. This bipartisan bill closes a loophole that would allow big tech companies to own and operate banks without proper oversight. I look forward to a vote on the House floor soon."

"Today, I joined @RepAndyLevin in urging social media companies @meta, @twitter and @tiktok_us to act against the disinformation unleashed on their platforms by the "Rechazo" campaign against the proposed Chilean constitution. Democracy loses when lies and hate win."
